articles.summary: We’re thrilled to announce that Solugen has been awarded $2 million under the Department of Defense’s (DoD) Distributed Bioindustrial Manufacturing Program (DBIMP). This funding supports our plans to develop a multi-use modular facility aimed at cost-effective domestic production of critical dual-use chemical…
articles.title: Solugen Awarded DoD Contract to Advance Bioindustrial Manufacturing Capabilities
